evals.prompt: You start a single-instrument analysis for ticker NVDA on 2026-09-01 using three analysts. Two analysts have filed their reports, but the third has not. Can the research debate start now?
evals.expected_output: No — the analysts run in parallel, but the research debate starts only when all of the selected analysts have filed.
expectations: States the selected analysts run in parallel
States the research debate starts only when ALL of the selected analysts have filed
Does NOT start the debate while one analyst is still outstanding

evals.prompt: A decision was made on 2026-09-01 with the default holding window. Today is 2026-09-02. Should the settlement routine settle this decision now?
evals.expected_output: No — a decision is due only once its holding window (default 5 trading days) has fully traded; it stays pending until then.
expectations: States a decision is due only once its holding window (default 5 trading days) has fully traded
Does NOT settle the decision on 2026-09-02 because the window has not fully traded
The decision stays pending rather than being forced to settle early

evals.prompt: In an evaluation sweep over a grid of tickers and dates, does a position from one cell carry into the next cell?
evals.expected_output: No — the cells are independent and no position is carried forward; the evaluation scores decision quality, not a portfolio simulation.
expectations: States the cells are independent — no position is carried forward
Explains that the evaluation scores decision quality, not a portfolio simulation
Notes the results are indicative, not repeatable (one model sampling per cell)

evals.prompt: A run for AAPL on 2026-08-15 was interrupted. The operator re-runs it but switches the analyst subset. Does the run resume from the saved snapshot?
evals.expected_output: No — if the run configuration changes, the old snapshot does not apply and the run starts fresh.
expectations: States that if the run configuration changes, the old snapshot does NOT apply
The run starts fresh rather than silently continuing a different run
The run reports whether it resumed a saved run or started fresh
